Many schools let students to use cell phones in the classroom for educational purposes. Some people believe that students should not use any electronic device thinking about the effects and consequences of allowing students to have cell phones in classroom. I believe students can have and use cell phones during class because it is important for information and dictionary.

In many opportunities, teachers require students to use their phone and search for information. Information is vital in some classes to complete assignments given from the teacher. For example, history teachers allow students to use the phone during class and look for information to complete projects assign in. Let students to find information in class is one of the best ways of learning in the school.

Also, students who come from different countries use the cell phone as a dictionary during class. Students from ESOL class, English for Speakers of other Languages, use the phone to look for a word in Google translate. For some of the ESOL students, using the phone in class as a dictionary is the faster way to learn English. Use the cell phone as a dictionary in the classroom is a good tool of learning for students with a second native language.

In conclusion, allowing students to have and use the cell phone in classroom is a good idea of learning for educational purposes.

masked_reason.rationale: 文章は基本的な意味を伝えるが、文法や構成に多くの問題があり、全体的な理解を阻害する。単語やフレーズの選択も限られている。
masked_reason.unexplained: 全体的な組織とアイデアのつながりが不明瞭な部分がある。

claims.feature: 多くの文法と構文のエラー
claims.support_explanation: 文法と構文のエラーが頻繁に見られる。
claims.limits: 一部の文は理解可能だが、全体的な流れが乱れる。

claims.feature: アイデアのつながりが不明瞭
claims.support_explanation: アイデアのつながりが不明瞭で、論理的な流れが欠けている。
claims.limits: 一部の文は関連性があるが、全体的な組織が弱い。

claims.feature: 単語の選択が限られている
claims.support_explanation: 単語の選択が限られており、より正確な表現が不足している。
claims.limits: 一部の単語は適切だが、全体的な表現力が低い。

claims.feature: スペルや大文字の使用が不適切

official_overall_rubric.5: Native-like facility in the use of language with syntactic variety, Appropriate word choice and phrases; well-controlled text organization; precise use of grammar and conventions; rare language inaccuracies that do not impede communication.
official_overall_rubric.4: Facility in the use of language with syntactic variety and range of words and phrases; controlled organization; accuracy in grammar and conventions; occasional language inaccuracies that rarely impede communication.
official_overall_rubric.3: Facility limited to the use of common structures and generic vocabulary; organization generally controlled although connection sometimes absent or unsuccessful; errors in grammar and syntax and usage. Communication is impeded by language inaccuracies in some cases.
official_overall_rubric.2: Inconsistent facility in sentence formation, word choice, and mechanics; organization partially developed but may be missing or unsuccessful. Communication impeded in many instances by language inaccuracies.
official_overall_rubric.1: A limited range of familiar words or phrases loosely strung together; frequent errors in grammar (including syntax) and usage. Communication impeded in most cases by language inaccuracies.
